business_problem: AME Digital needed stronger fraud prevention on top of rapidly growing customer and transaction volumes because peak demand periods and legacy workflows made anti-fraud operations costly and slow.
solution_summary: AME Digital uses Databricks Data + AI Platform, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, and MLflow to support payment fraud detection and large-scale data management. AME Digital needed stronger fraud prevention on top of rapidly growing customer and transaction volumes because peak demand periods and legacy workflows made anti-fraud operations costly and slow. In practice, the implementation stores or organizes core datasets in Delta Lake, governs access and lineage with Unity Catalog, runs transformation or AI logic on Databricks Data + AI Platform, and delivers outputs through Power BI. Transaction, claims, risk, and event data are consolidated into Delta Lake; Databricks Data + AI Platform applies analytics or model logic; results are surfaced through Power BI. The case study reports Combatting the impact of financial fraud 90%, Accuracy in fraud prevention models 3.2x, and More speed while running the model pipeline (vs. on-premises) 38%, showing measurable improvement after the rollout.
business_outcome: AME Digital reported Combatting the impact of financial fraud 90%, Accuracy in fraud prevention models 3.2x, and More speed while running the model pipeline (vs. on-premises) 38%, improving payment fraud detection and large-scale data management with measurable gains in risk reduction, cost reduction, and productivity improvement.
